jellyfin_12_behavior.detail: 107 of 364 operation declarations match; this does not measure compatible behavior. Audio metadata now registers bounded missing artist names with persistent library identities. Current permitted credit sources govern visibility; inactive identities and favorites survive rescans. The preceding tag-artist image matched twenty-two scoped membership comparisons, five artist details, four role lists and six mixed audio/album sort queries against the preserved public Jellyfin 12 reference. Five empty-credit queries and sixteen preceding artist-list queries also matched; two uncounted orders remain qualified. See jellyfin12-album-counts.md.
